problem: The Book parent already has separately qualified authorities that can commit parent-state successors, including Lifecycle Transition Engine and Integration Proposal Runtime V2. A complete version ledger must record those successors without re-executing their authority or creating a competing state-transition engine.

authorized_successor_ingest.meaning: Record an already-committed exact Book parent successor and its owning authority receipt into the immutable version ledger. This operation does not create, authorize or alter the supplied parent state.
required: exact committed post parent state version/digest
authority_receipt with exact matching pre/post parent identities
no object-version identity reuse with changed bytes
rules: The version ledger may accept only the exact already-committed post-state bytes bound by the authority receipt; it may not synthesize a different post state.
A mismatched, incomplete or unknown authority receipt fails closed.
Recording a Lifecycle successor does not grant Version/Rollback lifecycle authority.
Recording an Integration Runtime successor does not grant Version/Rollback provider-admission authority.
Recording author/export successors does not grant Version/Rollback author or publication authority.
The recorded successor receives immutable snapshot lineage and any newly observed governed object-version nodes receive exact digest/predecessor lineage.
Replay is idempotent; a conflicting request/idempotency identity fails closed.

internal_core_rule: version-and-rollback-core.js is an internal deterministic primitive. Authority-sensitive calls are exposed only through the registered public executable surface, which narrows lifecycle behavior and adds authorized-successor ingestion.
qualification_requirement: Qualification must prove exact authority-receipt binding, post-state identity preservation, lifecycle/runtime authority non-transfer, replay, mismatch rejection, object/history immutability and continued restore-as-new-successor behavior.
qualification_effect: NONE until the exact public executable subject and its fixtures pass hosted and registered A-01 qualification.
